turns.user_utterance: I’m encountering an issue where my card is being rejected at the ATM because the PIN is no longer being recognized.
turns.assistant_response: It sounds like the ATM isn’t accepting your PIN. Is the PIN being rejected because you entered it incorrectly too many times (PIN blocked), or are you entering the correct PIN but it still won’t work? If you can also confirm whether you’re seeing a “PIN failed/try again” message or a “card/PIN blocked” message, I’ll guide you to the right next step.

turns.user_utterance: I’m entering the correct PIN, but the ATM shows a “PIN failed – try again” message each time.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—if you’re entering the correct PIN and the ATM says “PIN failed – try again” every time, the most likely cause is that your PIN is blocked or not synced. Can you confirm whether you’ve tried the PIN multiple times at the ATM (often 3+ attempts)? If yes, you’ll need to unblock/reset your PIN—are you able to reset it in the app, or do you need help with the process?
